name: Ikeda (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ikeda town emblem in navy: a winged ring enclosing a stylised lozenge, with a stylised bird at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Ikeda, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1968.

features.role: Ikeda town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised lozenge, with a stylised bird at the fly
